headline: Web Developer
summary: IT support specialist with five years in schools, now moving into web development. For the past year I have built WordPress and hand-coded HTML, CSS and JavaScript sites for small businesses around Iloilo while still running help desk and network work at a private school. I am looking for a junior web developer role where I can learn a modern front-end framework properly.

experience.title: Web Developer
experience.paragraph: Evening and weekend work for local businesses that needed a first website or a cleaner one.
bullets: Built six WordPress sites, including a muscovado sugar cooperative's catalogue and a dental clinic's schedule page.
Hand-coded a one-page site in HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript for a Passi bakery, with a menu that owners edit from a simple list.

experience.title: IT Support Specialist
experience.paragraph: Sole IT staff for a private school of about 900 learners and 60 employees, covering the help desk, the campus network and the website.
bullets: Resolve help desk requests for teacher laptops, printers and the enrollment system, usually the same day.
Set up and look after the campus network, including separate VLANs for the two computer laboratories and the office.
Rebuilt the school website in WordPress and kept enrollment announcements current, which is how the freelance work started.
